annotations.title: Get a category's order for one country

description: The category's products as a reader in one country sees them: those available there, in order, with each one's published score and rank beside it. When nothing passes the country's availability filter, resultMode is "fallback" and the rows are the published order, none confirmed for that country.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet".

limit.description: How many rows, from the top (default 10).

name: get_ranking_for_country
title: Get a category's order for one country
